title: Zack Tabudlo to release song inspired by PBB's Jeo and Gehlee
summary: OPM singer-songwriter Zack Tabudlo is releasing a new single titled "Tsaka Nalang" inspired by watching Jeo and Gehlee, two of the new housemates in "Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0."
